business_summary: Indraprastha Gas Limited distributes and sells natural gas in India. It supplies compressed natural gas (CNG) to the transport sector; and piped natural gas to domestic, industrial, and commercial sectors. The company operates CNG stations, as well as steel pipeline and MDPE networks. It serves households; hotels, restaurants, malls, commercial complexes, educational/religious institutions, and hospitals; and metal, textiles, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, chemical, auto and ancillary, and packaging industries. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
